interpretation.open_exterior: The algebraic E_f pivot is strictly positive for alpha>=0 and r>r_H.
interpretation.horizon: The pivot has a double pole at x=0. This is a singularity of the algebraic elimination representation, not a physical divergence in the metric or a proof that F2 diverges.
interpretation.regularity_condition: A finite F2 requires cancellation between the pivot term and the remaining E_f numerator. The full coupled horizon Frobenius recurrence must derive that cancellation; it is not supplied by this pivot-only calculation.
interpretation.solver_implication: Use a horizon-regular series/variables on the inner patch and match to the algebraically reduced open-exterior DAE. Do not evaluate F2 by direct division at x=0.

claim_ceiling: Exact Laurent expansion of the algebraic E_f pivot only; not the full horizon Frobenius expansion, BVP solution, interval enclosure, or existence theorem.
